stem: The time, in minutes, taken by students to complete a test has the distribution $\text{N}(125, 36)$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the probability that the mean time taken to complete the test by a random sample of 40 students is less than 123 minutes.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain whether it was necessary to use the Central Limit theorem in the solution to part **(a)**.
